main.description: Give up one of the caller's deleted instances' 7-day grace period: it is purged at once, stops counting toward the instance limit, and can no longer be restored. Customers only.

id.description: The deleted instance's id, a UUID.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per request and resends on every retry of it.

purging.description: Always true: the instance is being purged.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a HappyProto customer, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: id or idempotencyKey is missing or not a UUID.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such instance, or another owner's.

errors.name: InvalidSlug
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: it reserves slugs by configuration as well.

errors.name: OperationInProgress
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: the instance is already changing, or a request with this idempotencyKey is still running.

errors.name: AccountSuspended
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: staff have suspended the account.

errors.name: PlanNotOffered
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: owners may not pick that plan themselves; it is available on request.

errors.name: NotInGrace
errors.description: The instance isn't deleted, or has already been purged.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers, or the job could not be started.
